core_obligations: Uniqueness of adjoints: by lemma-Rf-shriek-for-quasi-finite (tag 0GKM) the derived lower shriek Rf_! equals f_!, and lemma-lqf-shriek-derived (tag 0F5N) makes f_! the left adjoint of the lqf-derived Rf^!, while lemma-upper-shriek-derived (tag 0G2C) makes Rf_! the left adjoint of the representability-derived Rf^!; the two right adjoints of one functor are therefore the same (proof lines 4083-4086).
proof_roadmap: Identify the two left adjoints via Rf_! = f_! from the named lemma (proof lines 4084-4085).
Conclude the two Rf^! functors agree by uniqueness of adjoints (proof lines 4083-4084).
